title: PROFINET: IOCS and IOData object dissection with Multiple AR
description:
- When a new AR is established between devices which already has another AR, same station_info was used and it caused wrong dissection problem of IOCS and IOData objects of related AR. In order to fix problem, new struct is added in order to match station_info and corresponding ARs. New struct is used for keeping ARUUID, related inputCR and outputCR frame IDs and setup/release frame numbers of ARs. ARUUID's are used for adding station_info data to their corresponding conversations. If matching ARUUID and Frame IDs are found in RTC frame dissection, then corresponding IOCS and IOData objects are dissected.
- Rebase is done locally and merge conflicts are fixed

changed this line in [version 16 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/272/diffs?diff_id=113225000&start_sha=2e6c94f3f19022e2a52fab5ef07b705bc93ef64b#1b36b7bfc776219d717795216f2f236f9cff3255_11644_11645)
I've changed initialization and also clean up process of aruuid_frame_setup_list. As a result, these lines are removed.

I'm not familiar with the Profinet plugin but I find it suprising to have the aruuid_frame_setup_list definition and free in one file, and the allocation in another file. Initially I thought that the reset was missing because of that.
As a I said in previous comment, I've changed the initialization and clean up processes of aruuid_frame_setup_list. I think now it is the proper way.
isn't the strdup() done multiple times as the call to pn_find_dcp_station_info() is done multiple times

changed this line in [version 16 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/272/diffs?diff_id=113225000&start_sha=2e6c94f3f19022e2a52fab5ef07b705bc93ef64b#46834960d683bbfc272db7ec641cc72e02c201f8_1132_1130)

If dcp_station_info is not NULL, it is necessary to copy its values into station_info. That's why strdup() can be done multiple times. However, I've added strcmp function which compare values of station_info and dcp_station_info to each other. As a result, if they are already same values, strdup will not be called. But if they are different values, it is necessary to call strdup().
